_doc: ⚑ S394 (UiB job 27 Part B1–B3; S392, S390 before it) — THE LAMBY SET (LambyVision, src/room/lambyVision.ts) in its three places, how it is brought close, the bar under its picture, Lamby's line in view, and the moment's clock. One set, the same in all three rooms: the tapes change, the set does not. `place.pos` is the floor point under its hooves (world metres), `place.yaw` the turn about Y (0 = its glass faces +z/south; 180 north; −90 west). `seat` is the seat's eye (the probes' seat poses). Measured from the seat (tools/s394-lamby-tv-probe.mjs): 1997 on the chest of drawers behind Daniel's seat, ~120° right of the desk, ~2 m; 2016 on the low white unit by Vera's door (the south wall), ~90° left of the desk, ~1.4 m; 2026 on Maya's shelf plank where her old CRT stood, ahead and a little up, ~1.4 m.

1997._docPlace: on tvDresser (top y 0.58), facing into the room (west), where job 26 B put the TV; the VCR, the CRT, its panel and the VHS sleeve are gone from r1 (the set is all of them now)

2016._docS431: ⚑ S431 (UiB job 39 C; HEADSET_RUN_2026-11-26 answer d and finding 21 — his "it makes no sense to be like there … this is very difficult to see … if I continue it should just go back to their space", and where: "beside the monitor") — IN A HEADSET the brought set no longer takes S424's band above the monitor (in front of the calendar, small, his head tipped back): it stands BESIDE the monitor (`xrBeside`, src/room/teachingTv.ts xrBesidePlan) on the side away from the Handset Window (`side`: the Handset Window is the glass's right column, so left), its inner side `gapDeg` clear of the monitor's glass, its glass's centre at the height of the monitor glass's centre, at `depth` of the monitor's distance (a little nearer), turned to the eye, and as large as one Quest-like eye (`eyeDeg`: ~104° × 96°, the probes' convention, less `marginDeg`) can hold with the whole monitor beside it — one turn of the head toward it shows both whole. `xrFitDeg` no longer places it in a headset (kept for the record). The computer and the phone keep S424/S425's places. ⚑ And it goes back to its place when she continues: a lesson or another page of the platform opening is the story moving on (app.ts `page2016`, TeachingTvs.update), in every look. ⚑ Its offer (`offer`) is Lambient's own balloon on the monitor now, from its taskbar button (lambyGuideDraw), not the card in the room; left unanswered `offerHold` s it closes by itself and is logged as a let-go.
2016._docS424: ⚑ S424 (UiB job 35 Part D, Act I beat 5; his 23 Nov call 7: "Yes, but not mandatory") — 2016's moment is an OFFER (`offer`): after Lesson 1 and the Mentor's message the set lights by the door and Lambient asks once, in view; nothing comes or plays unasked. Brought (Bring it, or a press on the lit set at any time after), it stands BESIDE the monitor named `beside` (src/room/teachingTv.ts takeBeside, S412's grammar), never in front of it, and arrives stopped on its label, ▶ lit: nothing plays until her ▶. In a headset the whole set is kept inside `xrFitDeg` of the line of sight to the monitor (the mock's view is ±45°; its frame and keys in view, the monitor uncovered); on a phone held upright, where there is no room at the side, it stands above the monitor.
2016._docPlace: on wallTvUnit (top y 0.45), facing the seat (north); the wall TV, its DVD player, tray, light and the course's case are gone from r3

2026._docPlace: on e_shelfPlank (top y 1.14), facing the seat (south): Maya's shelf CRT (e_crtBody/e_crtBezel/e_crtScreen) is transformed into the set — her object kept, made an object of the time; the cream 2026 display on its arm (e26Display…) is gone from r4

held._doc: BROUGHT CLOSE (heldDevice's grammar). In a headset the glass comes `xrDist` m before the eyes (Meta's 0.5 m floor for anything looked at for long; ⚑ the headset seat's own monitor is 0.56 m from the eye — S374 — so at 0.6 the 1997 CRT stood in front of the set's glass in the probe's photographs: at 0.5 the set's face is the nearest thing), and the set grows until its PICTURE is `pictureDeg` tall (the brief: 25–30°). On a computer or a phone the set keeps its size and comes to the distance where its face — the glass's top to the keys' foot, 0.374 m — fills `flatFill` of the view's height (⚑ S394 fix: a phone `phoneFill`, the glass, the bar and the keys filling the height so its capitals reach 12 px, the keys whole on screen), never more than `flatMaxW` of its width (a portrait phone). The travel keeps `clearance` m from the eye and takes liftBase + liftPerMetre × the distance, at most liftMax s (smoothstep). `glowRest`/`glowHeld`: the body's self-light share (the 'system' tier's 0.34 in the room; more in the hand, its face turned from the lamp). `xrKey`: a key catches a headset's ray within this many metres (heldDevice's XR_BUTTON, wider for a larger key).
held._docS425: ⚑ S425 (UiB job 35 Part D; the coordinator's S424 follow-up: on the computer the brought set stood left of the monitor at a quarter of its width and its picture and captions could not be read from the seat) — `besideGlassOfMonitor`: on a computer the set brought beside the monitor is at least this wide in its glass, as a share of the monitor's width — at 0.33 the tape's caption letters (burned into the picture, v6: their tall letters 3.4 % of the glass's width) stand at least as tall as the monitor's body text (11 canvas px, its tall letters 0.72 of that, on a 676-px-wide canvas). When the seat's view has no room for it beside the whole monitor, the look is turned left, as little as it takes, at most `besideTurnMaxDeg`, the monitor kept whole (src/room/teachingTv.ts planBesideFor); it comes back when she puts the set back. A headset and a phone held upright keep S424's place (above the monitor), which already reads larger than the monitor's text (tools/s425-set-measure.mjs).

bar._doc: THE BAR UNDER THE PICTURE (B2; Part A's A1; ⚑ S394 fix, his "FIX first": the 2026 margin line ran off the bar's foot). The glass is 960 × 720 canvas px; the bar is at least `baseH` (a quarter of the glass) and as tall as the tape's tallest moment needs in this look-mode (wrapped first: every caption and margin line whole), at most `maxH`, the picture above it taking the rest. Capitals are asked for at `captionCap` / `marginCap` canvas px and never fall under the look-mode's floor: `floorDeg` in a headset, `floorPxComputer` CSS px on a computer, `floorPxPhone` on a phone (src/room/teachingTv.ts readingScale turns each into canvas px). `pad` above and below, `gap` between the caption and the margin, `lineK` the line height (× the font size).

call._doc: LAMBY'S LINE IN VIEW (B3): a card `w` m wide, `drop` degrees under the line of sight, `flatDist` m from the camera / `xrDist` m from the eyes (drawn over the room: nothing cuts it); turned more than `followDeg` away, it glides back into view over `follow` s.
call._docS431: ⚑ S431 (UiB job 39 C; his headset run 26 Nov, finding 20: "the buttons weren't working") — in a headset the card stood at 0.68 m, behind the 0.56 m monitor glass it was drawn over (the ray's dot on the glass, 11 cm behind the button it seemed to touch; no fingertip could reach it): `xrDist` 0.5 m (Meta's floor for a thing read; in front of the glass), its buttons 34 logical px tall (were 24) and the × a 34-px square: ~5° from the eye (were ~2.7°). 2016's offer is no longer on the card (Lambient's own balloon on the monitor); the card stays for a call made while the visitor may face away — no beat of the visit makes one now (1997's set comes from Did you know since S407, 2026's from Mum's link since S412, 2003 has no tape of its own), so it is reached through the review aid `__teachingTv.arm` only.

moment._doc: The moment's clock (no turns, no fades): `callHold` = the longest Lamby's line is given to be read before the set comes anyway (its yes sends it at once); `dismissBreath` = after × the set comes this long after; `noCall` = a call that never showed (the era's cap) lets the set come after this; `afterHold` = the end card held, the set in the hand, before the floor is free again; `afterDad` = the seconds Dad's two lines are given before his link; `noPlayRelease` = a tape that will not start lets the moment go after this.
moment._docS424: ⚑ S424 — `offerHold`: an OFFER (2016, `offer` above) left unanswered this long is let go — the same as Not now (its line, 12 words, reads in 6.8 s by the reading rule; this is twice that and a little). Nothing comes; the set stays lit by the door.
